top_signals.title: Greece Retail Sales Growth at One-Year High
top_signals.summary: Retail sales in Greece rose by 6.8% year-on-year in May 2026, rebounding from 0.3% decline in the previous month, highest reading since April 2025. The recovery was supported by stronger performance across major segments, with sales of non-food products excluding automotive fuel surging (7.7% vs -1.1% in April).
